messages:
Maya Thompson: Heads-up: launching a limited beta of 'Residency Locks' for Private/VPC customers next month. This is a per-tenant regional lock + export-control guardrails feature.

Owen Park: Nice. What's the migration story?

Maya Thompson: Migration is opt-in per tenant. Customers pick an allowed region set; any attempted export outside that set is rejected at the control plane and logged. No infra changes needed for the agent.

Diego Ramirez: Ops implications? Will this affect snapshots or offsite backups?

Maya Thompson: Snapshots remain in-customer storage. When customers enable Residency Locks we enforce an extra check on snapshot export endpoints; if KMS key region != allowed regions, export is blocked until customer rotates keys or updates allowed regions.

Priya Kapoor (Legal): Note on customer messaging: avoid implying jurisdictional legal advice. Suggested phrasing: "Residency Locks let customers constrain data movement to selected regions and demonstrate exports via signed attestations." We'll iterate the FAQ.

Owen Park: Is there an attestations API for audits?

Maya Thompson: Yes — signed attestation tokens with timestamp, region, and snapshot ID. Retention window configurable: 30/180/730 days.

Diego Ramirez: Rollback approach?

Maya Thompson: Admin toggle in Console. When toggled off, we still emit a depreciation log for 7 days to help audits. We also provide a dry-run mode so customers can simulate before enabling.

Support Bot: beta-deploy: residency-locks v0.1 -> staging completed :white_check_mark:

Owen Park: I'll add a short runbook and sample terraform snippet for customer enablement.

Maya Thompson: Action items: Priya to sign off on copy; Owen to prep runbook + snippet; Diego to validate export block tests in staging. Will invite 6 pilot customers next week.
